name: National Mission on Edible Oils – Oil Palm (NMEO-OP)
eligibility_facts: source states anyone is eligible to apply; state implementation and area expansion determine actual access
questions: Are you planning to grow oil palm or work on an oil-palm-related processing/business activity?
Which state and district are you in?

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: source states anyone is eligible to apply; state implementation and area expansion determine actual access

description.en: Anyone may apply, but actual access depends on state implementation and the selected oil-palm expansion area and must be confirmed separately.
description.or: ଯେକେହି ଆବେଦନ କରିପାରନ୍ତି, କିନ୍ତୁ ପ୍ରକୃତ ଲାଭ ରାଜ୍ୟ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନ୍ୱୟନ ଏବଂ ଚୟନିତ ତେଲତାଳ ବିସ୍ତାର ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ; ଏହାକୁ ଅଲଗା ଭାବେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।
